caption: The drawing depicts a square section of a textile or fabric sample centered on a blank, off-white background. The textile is rendered using a grid pattern that mimics the appearance of woven material. The composition within the square features intricate, repeating floral and botanical motifs. The motifs include stylized leaves, stems, and flower shapes, primarily rendered in two colors: red and blue. The background color of the textile appears tan or beige, representing the base weave. The blue elements are mainly leaves and a segment of a curved vine, while the red sections display various leaves, flowers, and frond-like structures. Small cross-shaped designs in red are also visible scattered within the pattern. The bottom right portion of the plain background outside the textile square has a small inscription or signature in fine letters.
title: Coverlet
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
